body:
Cards now support a start date/time and duration. An item with a time is an event; date-only start/end ranges remain planned work. The editor, hourly calendar, timeline, Focus attention and shared source/API contracts support this distinction.

Completed following the owner's instruction to finish the TODO. Verified with the full local gate, event-specific browser coverage, existing regression suites and a restart of the remote manual app. Evidence: progress/2026-09-26-timed-events.md.

Open decision: whether timed events should eventually replace milestones. Existing milestones remain separate dated checkpoints; no removal or conversion was requested or performed.

metadata.title: Add timed events with start time and duration
